perpetual_cycle.rule: The Sunday lectionary cycle repeats Year A, Year B, Year C. The app determines the liturgical year from the First Sunday of Advent and maps the Sunday position to the approved reference year for that cycle.
perpetual_cycle.note: Local diocesan calendar adjustments and official lectionary corrections should be verified and incorporated in future releases.
